name: Palladio Hotel Buenos Aires - MGallery
positioning: Boutique MGallery hotel in Buenos Aires's Recoleta neighborhood, in a building that was once a private palace, with a heated rooftop pool and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a Recoleta base close to Santa Fe Avenue shopping and the metro
Families who want connecting rooms and a rooftop pool

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of the traditional Recoleta neighborhood, steps from the Santa Fe Avenue shopping area.
The hotel is a two-minute walk from the Callao metro station.
Recoleta Cemetery is nearby, as are museums, bookshops and the Sunday flea market.
The hotel is part of Accor's MGallery Collection.
Rooms have large double-glazed windows that bring in plenty of light.
Room bathrooms are covered in marble, with a double sink and a separate shower.
All rooms have 24-hour room service, complimentary wifi, a minibar and a tea and espresso machine.
The hotel has a Spa and Wellness Center and a heated outdoor pool.
Spa facials use Germaine de Capuccini professional cosmetics.
The hotel has a modern gym.
Negresco Bistro serves Mediterranean cuisine with a seasonal menu and a list of local wines.
The hotel offers connecting rooms and a rooftop pool, which make it family-friendly.

highlights.text: Before it became the Palladio, the property was a private palace and later the birthplace of local politician Nicolas Rodriguez Pena.
The heated outdoor pool is on the rooftop and overlooks the neighborhood.
The Palladio Executive Suite is on the 14th floor with a view, and has living and dining spaces, a marble bathroom with a hydromassage tub, and a kitchenette.
La Terrazza serves cocktails, champagne and snacks with sunset views from the 11th floor.
The hotel has a solar-paneled rooftop terrace and a vertical garden of native species at the rear of the building.

considerations.text: The hotel is closer to the bustle of Avenida Santa Fe than to Recoleta's quieter residential pockets.
WhataHotel notes the hotel's intimate boutique size and limited facilities.
